hero.headline:
Love your pet.
Let us pamper them.
hero.subheadline: Award-winning grooming studio offering luxurious, stress-free experiences for dogs and cats in Boulder, Colorado.

about.headline:
A sanctuary
for the ones
you love most.
about.paragraph1: Pawfect Grooming was founded on a simple belief: every pet deserves to be treated like family. Our studio combines old-world craftsmanship with modern care techniques in a calming, spa-like environment.
about.paragraph2: Our team of certified groomers has over 35 years of combined experience. We never rush an appointment and always prioritize your pet's comfort and safety above all else.
about.founderQuote: Every pet who walks through our doors leaves happier than they arrived.

services.description: Complete bath, breed-specific haircut & style, nail trim, ear cleaning, teeth brushing, paw pad conditioning, and finishing touch with our signature cologne.
services.name: Signature Full Groom

services.description: Luxurious oatmeal or hypoallergenic shampoo bath, blow dry, full brush out, light trim around eyes & paws, nail trim, and ear cleaning.
services.name: Bath & Brush Out

services.description: Precision haircut tailored to your pet's breed standard or your personal style preference. Includes full bath, blowout, and finishing details.
services.name: Haircut & Styling

services.description: Expert nail trimming, paw pad shaping, soothing paw soak, cuticle care, optional nail polish in 6 beautiful colors, and moisturizing balm.
services.name: Pawdicure & Nail Trim

services.description: Professional teeth brushing using enzymatic toothpaste, breath freshening gel, and a gentle gum massage. Add-on available with any service.
services.name: Dental Care Treatment

services.description: Deep cleansing deshedding bath with Furminator treatment, high-velocity drying, and a special leave-in conditioning treatment that reduces shedding by up to 80%.
services.name: De-Shedding Spa Treatment

team.bio: Passionate about gentle handling and breed standard perfection. Sarah opened Pawfect after 8 years working in high-volume salons and decided pets deserved better.
team.name: Sarah Kline
team.title: Founder & Lead Stylist

team.bio: Known for his calm presence with anxious dogs. Mike specializes in large breeds and creative styling. He also trains new groomers across the Front Range.
team.name: Michael Torres
team.title: Master Groomer

team.bio: Our resident cat whisperer. Elena has a rare gift for making even the most reluctant cats feel safe and relaxed. She is also a certified cat behaviorist.
team.name: Elena Vargas
team.title: Feline Specialist

team.bio: The heart of our senior pet program. Patricia brings decades of experience and a gentle touch. She is also trained in canine and feline massage therapy.
team.name: Patricia Hale
team.title: Senior Groomer & Massage

testimonials.author: The Ramirez Family
testimonials.quote: Luna comes home looking like a completely different dog — in the best way. The team at Pawfect is incredibly patient with her anxiety. We won't go anywhere else.

testimonials.author: David & Priya Chen
testimonials.quote: I was nervous bringing our new rescue in. Patricia spent extra time with him and even sent photos during the appointment. He looked incredible and actually seemed relaxed.

testimonials.author: Margaret Holloway
testimonials.quote: My Persian cat, Clementine, is a total diva and refuses most groomers. Elena is magic. Clem now gets excited when we pull up to Pawfect. I never thought I'd see that day.

testimonials.author: The Whitaker Family
testimonials.quote: We drive from Denver every 6 weeks for our two Goldens. Worth every mile. The quality is unmatched and the whole experience feels genuinely caring, never transactional.
